# Gauge

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Circular or semicircular gauge with needle and colored ranges (NUM-103).

![Gauge, light theme](../img/widgets/gauge-light.png#only-light){ width="188" }
![Gauge, dark theme](../img/widgets/gauge-dark.png#only-dark){ width="188" }

schema [`gauge.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.Gauge(
    value=72,
    label="Gauge",
    unit="bar",
    peak_hold=True,
    ranges=[
        {"from": 0, "to": 60, "color": "#86efac"},
        {"from": 60, "to": 85, "color": "#fde047"},
        {"from": 85, "to": 100, "color": "#fca5a5"},
    ],
    size=(180, 180),
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"indicator"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |
| `variant` | `"circular"`, `"semicircular"` | `"circular"` | host |  |
| `ranges` | array of object | `[]` | host | Colored ranges drawn on the scale; unsafe colors are ignored (SEC-002). |
| `setpoint` | number or null | `null` | host | Setpoint drawn as a second, dashed pointer with a hollow marker, and stated in the text alternative; null: none (IND-116). |
